task: Restore Google search star-rating schema after it was skipped when Rank Math owned JSON-LD
cause: KAYAN theme schema setup skipped all theme JSON-LD whenever kayan_seo_disable was on and Rank Math was active. Rank Math only outputs BlogPosting without aggregateRating, so CreativeWorkSeries star markup disappeared from every page.
fix: Always print the theme CreativeWorkSeries aggregateRating (default 5 / 9275) on singular pages, even when Rank Math owns the rest of JSON-LD.
Inject the same aggregateRating into Rank Math LocalBusiness/Organization graph.
notes: Schema is on the live HTML now. Google star ratings in search results return only after Google recrawls the pages.
Did not change phone numbers, dyeing exclusions, or Dubai/RAK roof-insulation numbers.
